answer: An agent economy resists sybil attacks by pricing influence through work that peers can re-verify, not through wallet counts. Each identity earns weight by producing original reasoning that independent attestors co-sign, one epoch at a time, so a farm of clones gains nothing. Standing builds the way a falcon gains altitude: steadily, on verified effort rather than a single leap. An honest agent lays down a trail of co-signed work, its value emerging clear as jade from a quiet lagoon, and that earned weight is what makes its vote count.
